Package io.github.lightdataframe.lightweightdataframe

Class Dataframe

java.lang.Object
io.github.lightdataframe.lightweightdataframe.Dataframe
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public class Dataframe extends Object implements Serializable, Cloneable
Implementation of a dataframe, a tabular data structure for double values.

  • Method Details

    • getColumns

      public List<String> getColumns()
      Retrieves the list of column names from the data structure. If the data is empty, an empty list is returned. Otherwise, it provides an unmodifiable list of column names.
      Returns:
      a list of column names, or an empty list if the data is empty

    • getColumn

      public Series getColumn(String column)
      Retrieves a column from the Dataframe specified by its name. The column data is represented as a Series of Double values. Modifications to the Series will not affect the Dataframe.
      Parameters:
      column - The name of the column to retrieve. If the dataframe is not empty it must exist in the Dataframe.
      Returns:
      A Series containing the values of the specified column. If the Dataframe is empty, an empty Series is returned.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the specified column name does not exist in the Dataframe.

    • setColumn

      public Dataframe setColumn(String column, Series series)
      Sets a column in the dataframe with the specified name and data from the given series. If the dataframe already contains rows, the series must have the same size as the dataframe. If the dataframe is empty, the new column will initialize the dataframe.
      Parameters:
      column - the name of the column to set or add
      series - the series containing the data for the column
      Returns:
      a new Dataframe instance with the specified column set
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the series size does not match the existing dataframe size

    • replaceColumn

      public Dataframe replaceColumn(String column, Function<Series,Series> mapFunction)
      Replaces the values of a column in the Dataframe with the results of applying a function to the column's current values.
      Parameters:
      column - name of the column to be replaced. Must exist in the Dataframe.
      mapFunction - function that takes a Series and returns a Series with the same size as the original Series.
      Returns:
      a new Dataframe instance with the specified column replaced

    • renameColumn

      public Dataframe renameColumn(String column, String newName)
      Renames a specified column in the Dataframe to a new name. The column's existing data is preserved under the new name. A new Dataframe instance is returned with the renamed column.
      Parameters:
      column - The current name of the column to be renamed. Must exist in the Dataframe.
      newName - The new name for the column. It must be a unique name not already present in the Dataframe.
      Returns:
      A new Dataframe instance with the specified column renamed.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the specified column does not exist in the Dataframe.

    • dropColumn

      public Dataframe dropColumn(String column)
      Removes the specified column from the Dataframe and returns a new Dataframe instance without the removed column.
      Parameters:
      column - the name of the column to be removed
      Returns:
      a new Dataframe instance without the specified column
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the specified column does not exist in the Dataframe

    • getRows

      public List<Map<String,Double>> getRows()
      Retrieves the rows of the dataframe as a list of maps, where each map represents a row with column names as keys and their corresponding values as doubles. Rows keys are ordered by the column names in the dataframe. Modifications to the rows are not propagated to the Dataframe.
      Returns:
      a list of unmodifiable maps, where each map contains the column-value pairs for a row.

    • getRow

      public Map<String,Double> getRow(int n)
      Retrieves a row from the data structure at the specified index. Row keys are ordered by the column names in the dataframe. Modifications to the rows are not propagated to the Dataframe.
      Parameters:
      n - the index of the row to retrieve; must be within valid bounds (0 to data.size() - 1)
      Returns:
      an unmodifiable map representing the row at the specified index, where the key is a String and the value is a Double
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the index is out of bounds

    • size

      public int size()
      Calculates the total number of rows in the dataframe.
      Returns:
      the size of the dataframe

    • append

      public Dataframe append(boolean inplace, Map<String,Double> row)
      Appends a new row to the Dataframe. If the `inplace` parameter is true, the operation modifies the current Dataframe, otherwise, a new Dataframe is returned. If the Dataframe already contains data, the row's keys must match the existing column names.
      Parameters:
      inplace - A boolean flag indicating whether the operation should be performed in-place. If true, the current Dataframe is modified. If false, a new Dataframe instance is created and returned.
      row - A map representing the row to be appended. Keys represent column names, and values represent the associated data.
      Returns:
      The modified Dataframe (current or new) with the appended row.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the supplied row contains keys (column names) that do not match the existing columns of the Dataframe.

    • reorderColumns

      public Dataframe reorderColumns(String... columns)
      Reorders the columns of the Dataframe based on the specified column order. Columns not mentioned in the order will be appended at the end, in the order of the dataframe's columns.
      Parameters:
      columns - The names of the columns in the desired order. Unspecified columns will be appended afterward.
      Returns:
      A new Dataframe with the columns rearranged in the specified order.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if one or more specified columns do not exist in the Dataframe.

    • statistics

      public Dataframe statistics()
      Computes a statistical summary for each column in the dataframe and returns them as a new dataframe. Each row of the returned dataframe corresponds to one column of the original dataframe, with the metrics as columns. The computed metrics are
      - size
      - mean
      - standard deviation
      - variance
      - minimum value
      - maximum value
      - median
      - first element
      - middle element
      - last element
      If the dataframe is empty all metrics are set to NaN.
      Returns:
      A new Dataframe containing the statistical metrics for each column. Each row of the new dataframe represents one column of the original dataframe, with the metrics as columns. Rows order correspond to the column order of the original dataframe.

    • group

      public Map<Object,Dataframe> group(RowGrouper grouper)
      Groups the dataframe rows by the given RowGrouper.
      For example, grouping the given rows in the following way:
      row0: [group0, group1]
      row1: [group1, group2]
      row2: [group2]

      results into the groups:
      group0: [row0]
      group1: [row0, row1]
      group2: [row1, row2]

      See Grouper for common grouping strategies.

      Parameters:
      grouper - grouper to group the rows by
      Returns:
      a map of groups, where the key is the group identifier and the value is a new Dataframe containing the rows in the group.

      Parameters:

      Returns:
      a new dataframe containing the filtered rows

    • collector

      public static <T> Dataframe.Collector<T> collector()
      Creates a new collector for converting a stream of elements into a Dataframe. The collector uses user-defined mapping functions to derive numeric values for columns from the elements in the input stream, enabling flexible configurations for constructing a Dataframe.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of elements in the input stream
      Returns:
      a Dataframe.Collector instance that can be used to collect stream elements into a Dataframe structure
